subject: DPA addendum — model improvement opt-out, KMS routing & export guarantees
messages:
From: Amelia Soto <amelia.soto@wellcare.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-05-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: DPA addendum: model improvement opt-out + KMS residency

Hi David / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Legal asked me to follow up with a narrow set of asks we need to include in the DPA addendum before procurement can sign:

- A firm "no-model-improvement" commitment for our tenant data (no training, no fine-tuning, no aggregate improvements) unless explicitly opted into later.
- Clear ownership language: customer retains all rights to prompts and model responses we send/receive; Redwood may not assert derivative rights.
- KMS residency requirement: keys for any customer-controlled encryption must be hosted in the US (we prefer US-West) and not egressed. If you use a managed key, we need proof of region and export policy.
- Evidence and auditability: sample audit logs for exports, a one-off proof package (redaction-safe), and a path to SFTP/secure API export of tenant-level transcripts for verification.

We are attaching a redline of the clause the legal team drafted (see attachment). Two practical questions from procurement: can Redwood provide an operational checklist / runbook describing how you implement the no-train toggle (so we can show compliance to our SOC team), and what is the turnaround to deliver the audit package?

We prefer to avoid escalating to legal unless language is straightforward — can we aim to resolve by end of next week? Happy to hop on a short call.

Thanks,
Amelia Soto
Head of Legal Ops, WellCare.ai
amelia.soto@wellcare.ai
+1 (415) 555-0112

Attachment: WellCare_DPA_redline_v3.pdf
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Soto <amelia.soto@wellcare.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-05-19T12:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA addendum: model improvement opt-out + KMS residency

Hi Amelia — thanks for the clear list. Appreciate the redline; I reviewed with Kimberly and Jonas. Short answers and next steps below.

1) No-model-improvement commitment: yes — we can offer a contractual "no model improvement" clause scoped to tenant data (we already support request-level toggles for learning). I attached an internal draft clause that mirrors your redline but keeps operational controls explicit (see attached).
2) Prompt/response ownership: we can accept customer ownership of prompts and responses. We'll add explicit language that Redwood disclaims derivative model IP for those interactions.
3) KMS residency: we support customer-managed keys via our KMS integration. Keys can be restricted to US regions; Jonas (cc'd) can confirm what we lock by default and options for an HSM-backed key.
4) Evidence / audit package: we can provide a one-time evidence bundle (export logs, config snapshot, and S3/SFTP export traces). To be explicit: we will provide log extracts and a redaction-safe transcript sample; the full tenant export will be delivered via SFTP or secure API per your preference.

Operational asks: can you confirm the SFTP endpoint details or if you prefer a short-lived S3 presigned upload? Also, can you confirm if procurement requires DocuSign or an internal signature flow first?

Proposed next step: Jonas and I will prepare a short operations runbook (2–3 pages) describing how the no-train toggle is enforced end-to-end, and we can share it by Wednesday 2025-05-21. If that works, we can close this without further legal redlines.

I'll attach our redline for your review. If the redline is acceptable, we can route to DocuSign.

Best,
David Kim
Head of Privacy & Compliance, Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.ai
+1 (650) 555-0199

Attachments: WellCare_DPA_redline_v3.pdf, kms-key-residency-matrix.xlsx
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amelia Soto <amelia.soto@wellcare.ai>
Date: 2025-05-20T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA addendum: model improvement opt-out + KMS residency

David / Kimberly / Amelia (looping in publicly for transparency) — quick technical note on feasibility and delivery timelines.

- KMS residency: we can bind customer master keys to the us-west-2 region via our cloud KMS integration. For HSM-backed keys (customer-provided or partner HSM) we need a short onboarding (1 week) and a simple network ACL to prevent export. We cannot ship a physical HSM to you, but we can support BYOK with HSM-backed clouds.

- No-train toggle: implemented at the inference routing layer. When the toggle is enabled for an account, request payloads are marked as non-consumptive; telemetry is still collected for reliability (error counts, latency) but request/response content is excluded from training pipelines and our aggregation buckets. The KV cache is ephemeral per-session and not persisted to training corpora.

- Evidence package: we can produce a package containing:
  * config snapshot (toggle state, timestamps)
  * export audit logs (SFTP transfer logs or API export audit entries)
  * runtime traces with redaction markers (non-content telemetry)

Estimated delivery windows:
  * Operations runbook (2–3 pages): 2 business days (by 2025-05-21)
  * One-off evidence bundle: up to 10 business days after request depending on redaction/PII review (target 2025-05-30)

Implementation notes / constraints:
  - If you require monthly recurring extracts for ongoing attestation, we should add that to the SOW (ops cost).
  - For SFTP exports we need an endpoint + public key; for presigned S3 we need bucket details and IAM role.

Happy to join a 30-min technical call if you'd like to walk through the runbook.

— Jonas
Principal Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
From: Amelia Soto <amelia.soto@wellcare.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Jason Li <jason.li@wellcare.ai>
Date: 2025-05-22T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA addendum: model improvement opt-out + KMS residency

Thanks, David and Jonas — this is helpful and addresses the team's main concerns.

Procurement confirmed they will accept the contractual redline if you include the operations runbook and evidence timeline in the addendum (we'll attach those as an appendix). We prefer SFTP transfer for the one-off export — I'll have Jason send the endpoint and public key by EOD tomorrow.

A couple of small asks to include in the appendix:
- A short statement (1–2 sentences) that telemetry retained for reliability is non-content (no prompt/response payloads are used for model improvement).
- Confirmation that HSM/BYOK options will not result in key export and that region locks will be documented in the evidence package.

If you can share the 2–3 page runbook on Wednesday and a draft of the appendix language we can route to DocuSign and close the SOW. Appreciate the quick turnaround — would like to mark this done in HubSpot this week.

Best,
Amelia Soto
Head of Legal Ops, WellCare.ai
amelia.soto@wellcare.ai
